paragraphs: It is hereby ordered that Pelican Island in Indian River in section nine, township thirty-one south, range thirty-nine east, State of Florida, be, and it is hereby, reserved and set apart for the use of the Department of Agriculture as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.
uo-054.collated_against: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service image of the signed original; collated again word for word against the period White House file copy (dated "March 14th, 1903"), 2026-08-21
uo-054.notes: The order is a single sentence; the heading (WHITE HOUSE, March 14, 1903) and signature are not reproduced in the research entry. Numbers are spelled out as in the original; the doubled commas in "be, and it is hereby, reserved" are original.
